module: Processes the jbeam "occupantSlots" section (occupant seats). Normalizes each entry: id (id, name or table key), defaultPermissionMode (driver, passenger or unrestricted; otherwise inferred from the camera), seatSide (left/right/center, inferred from exitSide, driverSide or the L/R suffix of the id), cameraName 'occupant.<id>', entryTrigger 'enterSeat_<id>', cargoGroup '<id>Occupant' and actionMaps (always a table). Produces vehicle.occupantSlotsById and enables vehicle.occupantSystem.enabled if there are seats or if an active part exposes a slot of type 'seat_occupant'.
notes: Duplicate ids are rejected with a log error (the second entry is ignored).
An invalid defaultPermissionMode produces a warning and is then replaced: 'driver' if cameraName is 'driver', otherwise 'passenger'.
cameraName is always rewritten to 'occupant.<id>', whatever the original value; the original value is only used to infer the permission mode.
The first parameter (objID) is ignored; only called on the GE side (vmType == 'game').

process.desc: Normalizes the vehicle's occupantSlots and enables the occupant system if needed.

activePartsData.desc: Active parts (used to detect a seat_occupant slot).
